explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. The theorem says that precomposing with r gives a bijection from the lifts of f (A simply connected) to the lifts of f ∘ r (B preconnected). I read through `Mathlib/Topology/Homotopy/Lifting.lean`. It has `existsUnique_continuousMap_lifts` (existence and uniqueness of a lift through a chosen point), path lifting, homotopy lifting and monodromy. None of these states a bijection on lifts induced by precomposition, and no lift-equivalence type appears there. A grep for `continuousMapLiftEquiv`, `liftEquiv` and `precomp` in `Mathlib/Topology/Covering` returned nothing. `continuousMapLiftEquiv`, which the proof uses, belongs to the library, not Mathlib. The proof itself has some substance: it combines that equivalence with uniqueness of lifts (`eq_of_comp_eq`) on the preconnected space B, so it is not a one-line instance of any Mathlib lemma.
